content.short: Mercato is the primary NFT aggregator on Aptos, providing unified liquidity and professional trading tools.
content.description: Mercato is the definitive NFT marketplace aggregator built natively for the Aptos blockchain, designed to provide users with deep liquidity and the best possible prices across the ecosystem. By aggregating listings and bids from all major marketplaces, Mercato offers a unified and efficient interface for trading digital assets. The platform features professional-grade tools such as real-time floor price tracking, advanced filtering, and instant sweep functionality.
